summary: Frontend-only verification of iter247 role-switcher dropdown in Nav.jsx. Ran 9 Playwright scenarios on the preview URL covering no-auth, single-role, multi-role, dropdown open/items, navigation, active indicator, sign-out-all, escape/outside-click close, and mobile hide. All 9 scenarios functionally pass. The critical ternary at Nav.jsx line 133 (signedInRoles.length > 1) cleanly excludes one of [nav-signin-btn] / [nav-role-switcher-btn] in every state — no DOM coexistence bug.

integration_issues.issue: Not a bug — observed during testing: routes /maker/dashboard and /admin/dashboard have client-side auth guards that redirect to /maker/login and /admin/login when the JWT fails server validation (expected with raw fake strings). Buyer route /community/me has no guard and resolves directly. Dropdown link hrefs are correct (verified in ROLE_META).

t1_noauth_baseline.note: localStorage cleared → nav-signin-btn visible with text 'Sign in' (rendered 'SIGN IN' via CSS uppercase); nav-role-switcher-btn absent.

t2_single_role_admin.note: Only cm_admin_jwt set → nav-signin-btn visible with text 'Account'; nav-role-switcher-btn absent.

t3_multi_role_admin_maker.note: Both cm_admin_jwt + cm_maker_jwt set → nav-role-switcher-btn visible; nav-signin-btn absent. Ternary mutual-exclusion verified.

t4_dropdown_open_three_roles.note: All 3 JWTs set, click switcher → menu + 3 role rows (admin/maker/buyer) + signout button all render.

t5_dropdown_navigation.note: maker row → /maker/dashboard (redirects to /maker/login due to invalid fake JWT — guard behaviour). admin row → /admin/dashboard (redirects to /admin/login). buyer row → /community/me (direct). Link hrefs in ROLE_META are correct.

t6_active_indicator.note: With admin+maker+buyer, admin row text = 'ADMIN\n◆ NOW' (active per priority admin>maker>buyer). Maker/buyer rows have no 'now' marker.

t7_signout_all.note: Click nav-role-switcher-signout → localStorage cm_admin_jwt + cm_maker_jwt + cm_maker_jwt_exp + cm_buyer_jwt all null. Redirected to /.

t8_close_on_escape_and_outside_click.note: Escape closes menu. Mousedown outside switcher ref closes menu.

t9_mobile_hides_switcher.note: 375x800 viewport — nav-role-switcher-btn renders in DOM (parent has 'hidden sm:inline-block') but is not visible. Mobile drawer hamburger remains.

critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx is 649 lines — borderline. Consider extracting RoleSwitcher into its own file (e.g. /app/frontend/src/components/sections/nav/RoleSwitcher.jsx) for maintainability.

readSignedInRoles() only checks key presence, not JWT validity. If an expired/revoked token sits in localStorage, the user sees the role switcher but every dashboard nav redirects to login — slightly confusing UX. Acceptable for current scope but worth a follow-up to gate by token validity or at least expiry timestamp (cm_maker_jwt_exp already exists for maker).
test_credentials: None used — raw non-empty strings injected directly into localStorage keys cm_admin_jwt / cm_maker_jwt / cm_buyer_jwt.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter247 RoleSwitcher implementation in /app/frontend/src/components/sections/Nav.jsx verified end-to-end. Ternary at line 133 correctly mutually-excludes nav-signin-btn vs nav-role-switcher-btn across no-auth / single-role / multi-role states. When testing navigation with FAKE JWTs, /maker/dashboard and /admin/dashboard will redirect to their /login pages due to server-side JWT validation — this is expected guard behaviour, not a switcher bug. Use real JWTs (or a credentialed account) if you need to verify the destination pages render fully.
